snippet.title: The Fight: Lights Out™ Set Up Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch The Fight: Lights Out™  tutorial trailer and learn how to set up your gaming area and the PlayStation Eye camera to give you the most accurate motion tracking possible and make sure every punch leaves your opponent hurting!


The Fight: Lights Out © 2010 Sony Computer Entertainment Europe.  "The Fight: Lights Out" is a trademark of Sony Computer Entertainment America LLC. 

The PlayStation®Eye camera (sold separately) is required to use this product.

Full HD 1080p requires an HDMI cable and a 1080p native display with an HDMI input supporting HDCP.  Video out in HD requires cables and an HD compatible display, both sold separately.  This video will play displays ranging from standard definition to 1080p.
